prompt: Add a /help admin command that lists the available admin commands to the admin who typed it (use Log.info on the server; no new UI).
result_text:
I added `/help` to `src/server/services/AdminService.luau`, registered alongside `/coins` and `/kick` in `registerDefaults`. It logs the usage string of every registered admin command, sorted by name, using `Log.info`. The header line names the admin who ran it.

Two things to know:

- **The output goes to the server console, not the admin's chat.** `Log.info` writes to server output, so the admin won't see the list in-game unless they can read server logs. That matches your "use Log.info, no new UI" instruction, but if you wanted it visible in-game, that would need a chat message or a UI change.
- **I haven't run it.** The project isn't a git repo and I have no Luau runtime here, so I checked the edit by reading the code. The `/help` entry appears in its own output because it's registered before the list is built.

			for name in pairs(commands) do
				table.insert(names, name)
			end
			table.sort(names)

			Log.info("AdminService", admin.Name, "requested the command list:")
			for _, name in names do
				Log.info("AdminService", commands[name].usage)
